items.title: 68191_William (Bill) H. Challis Oral History Interview
items.q: I played with Alphe and I would occasionally get a job up in Scranton.

ctx.x: So that was when I was a senior in high school. So I supposed I had that distinction. I was their first saxophone player, although Sid Trucker, I think they had him, but he played mostly clarinet. They didn't like his saxophone playing, his tone. They thought I had a pretty good tone.
So now we used to go around to hear that band, the Dorsey brothers got into that band and oh, eventually the Dorsey brothers got in it, Joe and Eddie got in it. Alphe Evans got in it.
I played with Alphe and I would occasionally get a job up in Scranton.
